newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: MRC up 6.15 pct in late brisk trade.
newsitem.headline: MRC up 6.15 pct in late brisk trade.

text.p: Industrial estate developer MRC Allied Industries rose by 6.15 percent to 3.45 pesos on speculation that companies had started buying plots in its estate on the central island of Cebu, brokers said.
"We heard that several companies have signed up to locate in its Cebu estate," Julie Villena of Dharmala Securities said.
A total of 24.5 million shares were traded until about 30 minutes before the close of session.
"Everything is set right now ... (The sales) should turn out well for its bottomline," Villena said.
